channel.title: The Countertop Guide
channel.description: Spec-backed air fryer and meat thermometer buying guides, written from the Amazon listing.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Dual-basket for two dishes at once, French-door for a crowd, single basket for a shallow counter - decided on listing facts, not on testing we have not done.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts versus litres, split baskets and what a 'feeds 4-6' claim actually claims: a checklist you can run on any listing in five minutes.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Dishwasher-safe parts as listed, footprint arithmetic and capacity per centimetre of counter depth for three verified air fryers.

item.title: What fits under the cabinet? Checking counter height
item.description: A tape-measure walkthrough for the vertical number listings publish but shoppers skip: listed height, clearance, and what a cabinet really needs.

item.title: Air fryer accessories: what comes in the box
item.description: Racks, baskets, rotisserie spit and the included-components field: how to check what arrives before you buy, using three listings as worked examples.

item.title: Is that air fryer actually on sale? How to check
item.description: Six checks on any discounted kitchen-appliance listing: which variant you are priced on, what the struck-through figure refers to, and where returns actually stand.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Presets, accessories, wattage, warranty and fit: the questions to ask a multi-function oven listing before paying for functions you will not use.

item.title: Instant-read or wireless? How to read accuracy claims
item.description: What a stated tolerance, a named certification, a sensor count and 'unlimited range' do and do not prove - for a handheld and a wireless probe set.

item.title: Holiday air fryer gifts: how to choose one that gets used
item.description: Five questions that predict whether a gifted air fryer stays on the counter: depth, household size, cleanup, control panel and returns.

item.title: The holiday hosting test: which air fryer feeds a crowd?
item.description: Holiday hosting answers from verified Amazon listings: two dishes at once, rotisserie and pizza claims, and the counter-depth math that decides fit.

item.title: Kitchen gifts by budget: $25, $80 and $150 bands
item.description: Gift bands from five verified Amazon listings: who each pick is for, the listings' own gift claims quoted, and a gift-giver's checklist.

item.title: Will it trip the breaker? Air fryer wattage and outlet math
item.description: What 1000W vs 1700W means on a 120V circuit, the wattage conflict on one listing, and a checklist for verifying wattage on any listing.
